upstreams.name: mac-custom
upstreams._note: Self-hosted OpenCode LLM on the user's Mac via localtunnel — NO provider quota, first in chain for daily dev/test. The router routes by model name, so sessions must request oc/big-pickle to reach it. Tunnel is flaky (502/408 on first attempts, verified 2026-09-15) — retrying the request usually succeeds. Not a real-provider-compat proxy: no geminiThoughtSignatures here (different protocol).

upstreams.name: zen
upstreams._note: big-pickle free tier is OpenCode-client-only (MissingSessionID 2026-09-15); glm-5.3-flash is the fallback free candidate — probe before relying on it

upstreams.name: gemini-openai
upstreams._note: gemini-2.5-flash retired for new users (provider 404 2026-09-15 names gemini-3.6-flash as replacement). ROLE: real-provider compatibility verify (thought_signature etc.) before production — free tier RPD=20, do NOT use for daily dev (mac-custom covers that).
